name: Gasthof Fuchsanger
beschreibung:
Perched on a scenic elevation in Rettenschoess, Gasthof Fuchsanger welcomes guests with heartfelt hospitality and tasty Tyrolean home cooking. Bright rooms offer sweeping mountain vistas.

Lake Walchsee, panoramic footpaths, and cross-country ski trails are just a few minutes drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Fuchsanger in Rettenschoess offers traditional comfort and mountain views in Kaiserwinkl.
